# Abin da muke aiki a kai

Shirin gyare-gyare na matakai, da aka zana lokacin ginawa daga ma'aunin [plan.md](https://github.com/LilyDesignSystem/lily-design-system/blob/main/plan.md) na ma'ajiyar. Jerin dubawarsa yana a [tasks.md](https://github.com/LilyDesignSystem/lily-design-system/blob/main/tasks.md); ana haɗa aikin da aka kammala cikin [littafin canje-canje](https://github.com/LilyDesignSystem/lily-design-system/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md). Kamar kowace taswirar hanya, tana iya canzawa.
